current.text: He is expected to start on opening night. The Warriors look set to start Podziemski, Santos and Lendeborg, with Draymond Green at center.
The Warriors seem to leave Porzingis out of the starting lineup.
With Porzingis out, a usage rate above 20 is possible for him.
After last season's trade deadline he ranked 72nd, up from 302nd before it. In that stretch he played 31 minutes and averaged 15 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 1.5 steals.
Some of his shooting last season was fluky and may not hold.
Experts call him a late flyer, worth a pick around 122 or in rounds 11 to 13. He could be top 70 after the trade deadline.
Josh still prefers Podziemski and Lendeborg to him.
Draft him together with Yaxel Lendeborg as a hedge for the same minutes, and keep whichever one wins the role.
Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody are out early in the season. Butler is out for at least half the season.
The rotation could change when Butler and Moody return, and that could cut into his role.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year and are worried about lottery odds. They may rest veterans.
Rest days for the veterans should give him enough minutes.
Warriors depth is very poor. They struggle to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes go up across the rotation.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most. Their schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He can create his own shot, which almost nobody on the Warriors besides Curry can do. He also has size.
He scores much more when Curry is out than when he plays alongside him.
Steve Kerr runs unpredictable rotations. He often announces a starting lineup and changes it a few games later, with a lot of mixing among the wings.

note: Both sites give him 0 USD in value. Yahoo ranks him 138 and ESPN 249, and nobody drafted him in our league last season, so in a 144-player draft he is a 1 USD last-round flyer at most. His projected category line has no strong or weak outlier (PTS z -0.9 is his worst), so he fits any build as filler rather than as a category target. If you draft him, pair him with Lendeborg as a hedge. In the first two weeks, check that he is still starting and playing near the 31 minutes he played after last year's deadline, and watch for changes when Butler and Moody return.
